# East Bay Sewer Inspection

> East Bay Sewer Inspection explains the EBMUD Regional Private Sewer Lateral (PSL) ordinance: when a Compliance Certificate is needed to close escrow in Oakland, Alameda, Albany, Emeryville, Piedmont and the Stege Sanitary District, how the verification test works, and Berkeley's separate program.

It is for East Bay home sellers, buyers, agents and escrow officers. It also lists 41 contractors from EBMUD's PSL contractor list (a courtesy list, August 2026) whose CSLB licenses are active. Contractors can use the list-your-business page. Every page has a Markdown version: replace the trailing slash with `.md` (home: https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/index.md).

## Guides hub
- [East Bay sewer lateral guides](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/guides/): all guides in one place

## Guides
- [EBMUD Sewer Lateral Certificate: Selling an East Bay Home](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/ebmud-psl-program/): how the certificate works
- [EBMUD Sewer Lateral Program: Participating Cities](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/cities/): participating cities
- [East Bay Sewer Lateral Certificate Fees & Replacement Costs](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/sewer-lateral-cost/): EBMUD fees and cost factors
- [EBMUD Sewer Lateral Contractor List (41 Contractors)](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/contractors/): 41 contractors from EBMUD's courtesy list with active CSLB licenses and their services; how to vet
- [East Bay Sewer Lateral Inspection: Camera Check & EBMUD Test](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/sewer-lateral-inspection/): how the inspection and verification test work
- [Sewer Lateral Replacement Cost in the East Bay (EBMUD)](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/sewer-lateral-replacement-cost/): published fees, cost factors and what a bid should include
- [Who Is Responsible for the Sewer Lateral? East Bay City Rules](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/sewer-lateral-responsibility/): Who owns which part of the lateral in each city (upper vs lower), the local code that requires upkeep, and the permit office to call.
- [EBMUD Time Extension Certificate: $4,500 Deposit & 180 Days](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/time-extension-certificate/): Closing before the lateral is fixed: the $142 fee, the $4,500 refundable deposit, the 180-day clock and how the refund works.
- [Sewer Lateral Exemptions: Inheritance, Trusts, Divorce (EBMUD)](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/sewer-lateral-exemptions/): Inheritance, living trusts, divorce, family and LLC transfers that don't trigger the certificate, plus septic and no-lateral exemptions.
- [Selling or Buying a Condo: EBMUD Sewer Lateral & HOA Rules](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/condo-hoa-sewer-lateral/): Condo and townhome sales: HOA vs unit owner responsibility, the Statement of Responsibility, and what buyers should ask for.
- [Does This House Have a Sewer Lateral Certificate? How to Check](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/check-sewer-lateral-certificate/): For buyers and owners: look up a property's certificate status, how long certificates last (7 or 20 years), and voluntary certificates.
- [Remodeling Over $100,000? The EBMUD Sewer Lateral Rule](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/remodeling-sewer-lateral-certificate/): Remodeling an existing East Bay home for more than $100,000: when the certificate is due, the steps, and Berkeley's building-permit rule.

## Get free quotes
- [Get free quotes](https://eastbaysewerinspection.com/quotes/): one free request to up to 3 sewer lateral contractors on EBMUD's PSL contractor list (active CSLB licence) near a ZIP code (or a chosen listing plus the 2 nearest others). Available where the EBMUD sewer lateral rule applies: Oakland, Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Emeryville, Piedmont, El Cerrito, Kensington and the Richmond Annex.
